title: SCHC session expiry leaves FragmentSender active and cancellation incoherent
description: Correctness review: manager expiry removes the session, but FragmentSender.status remains active. timeout() then raises and cancel() calls finish() and raises, leaving state and cleanup incoherent. Synchronize expiry into a terminal sender state and make cancellation idempotent after expiry; cover concurrent/boundary behavior.
notes: Additional correctness detail: FragmentSessionManager.finish() does not run expiry. Calling cancel directly after the deadline marks aborted, while timeout-then-cancel leaves active and both calls error. Expiry and terminal transition must be order-independent.
